meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前,先产出一份能直接照做、决策完整的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次开工前都想先把实现方案定死、再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough idea into a decision-complete work plan before writing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the implementation plan locked down before you start coding

howto.what: 它把 Claude 变成只读的策划顾问:先探索代码库,再写出一份决策完整的实施计划文件,自己不碰产品代码、也不实现。只有你明确说可以,计划才落到 .omo/plans 下。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求 ulw-plan 流程或先出计划时启用,单独的 ulw 运行不会自动激活;此时「做 X」「修 X」「直接做」都按「先规划 X」处理。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流
say.note: 先探索代码,再产出决策完整的计划

say.text: 先把这个改动的计划给我看,别动代码
say.note: 不获批就不会写计划文件

say.text: 这份计划要跑高精度复核
say.note: 计划会标记为必做 plan-reviewer 复核

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a read-only planning consultant: it explores the repo, then writes one decision-complete work plan file under .omo/plans. It never edits product code or implements; the plan is written only after you say okay.
howto.when_en: Only activates when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it. Then "do X" or "fix X" all mean "plan X".

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan a 5/min-per-IP rate limit on /login
say_en.note: It explores first, then writes the plan

say_en.text: Show me the plan before any code changes
say_en.note: No plan file until you approve
